## Grammar
Write SPARQL only.
Classes: Person

## Examples
Q: list every person
```sparql
SELECT ?p WHERE { ?p a ex:Person }
```

## Known entities
Use the exact IDs below.

- <http://ex.org/w1> — "Sentinel Widget XYZ123" (Widget)

## Known schema predicates
Use only these predicates.

- sentinelPredicateXYZ123 — "pv:sentinelPredicateXYZ123" (Widget -> xsd:string) [datatype]

## Known navigation paths (use a SHARED variable per hop)
These are the ONLY valid multi-hop joins from the grounded entity above to the requested target. Render each as a shared-variable join (a single intermediate variable reused across hops), never as separate, unconnected triples.

- Employee -> hasManager -> Manager: `<ANCHOR> hasManager ?result .`
